title: Bilateral hypoglossal nerve stimulation for obstructive sleep apnea: a nonrandomized clinical trial
comparison_or_design: The primary 12-month bilateral hypoglossal nerve stimulation assessment.
observations_or_assays: AHI response under the coprimary criterion
ODI response under the coprimary criterion
excluded: Continuous ODI, oxygenation, other follow-up and patient-reported outcomes
population_or_material: The source-defined populations for the selected coprimary outcomes and Table 2 continuous-AHI summaries, together with the reported participant-flow context necessary to interpret these analyses.
requested_items: Primary worst-case-imputed AHI/ODI responder counts/proportions/performance-goal tests and Table 2 paired continuous total-AHI baseline/12-month summaries/change/test. Exclude PP/FAS sensitivity responses, unrelated baseline denominators and positional/REM/NREM AHI subdivisions.
